items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: So we had Willie the Lion Smith playing opposite me.

ctx.x: With Herb Ward, the bass player. But do carry your clarinet, so if you feel like blowing, start blowing from the table. It sounded good, looked good.
And that's what we did. And then we got Willie the Lion Smith, we grew in stature. We got Chippy Hill, we got Willie. It got to be a place to go.
